title: honey-glazed peruvian sweet potato picarones
description: sour, fluffy, ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly peruvian dish featuring capers and lardons, perfect for a post-workout snack or dessert
instructions: preheat the iron teppan to 375 41212123°f (190°c) or the highest heat setting.
cut 2 large sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces and boil in a saucepan until tender, about 15-20 minutes.
drain sweet potatoes and mash in a large bowl.
add 1 large egg, 1/4 cup honey, 2 tablespoons capers, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
dust the iron teppan with 2 cups all-purpose flour.
using a piping bag or a spoon, create small balls of the dough and drop them onto the preheated teppan.
fry the picarones until golden brown on the bottom, about 2-3 minutes.
flip the picarones and fry the other side until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
serve the picarones hot and drizzle with lardons-render and honey glaze.
using a spoon, drizzle the lardons-render over the picarones in a circular motion.
using a spoon, drizzle the honey glaze over the picarones in a circular motion.
